title: EEG-based brain-computer interface enables real-time robotic hand control at individual finger level
primary_outputs: Offline/fine-tuned finger classifier metrics on held-out recorded sessions.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: 21subject MAT archives; observed ZIP member inventory supports eeg.data128channels×time,1024Hz and1-based event samples by publisher/source documentation, not executed payload validation.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: Publisher schema and source loader agree: eeg.data128channels ×time, eeg.fsample1024Hz, eeg.time andchannel labels.
data_contract.labels: event.type Target/TrialEnd, event.sample1-based sample index, event.value1thumb/2index/4pinky; source subtracts1before slicing.
data_contract.leakage: Online files also contain prediction and prob_* output fields; these must be removed from candidate inputs, along with evaluation event targets.
data_contract.split: Reproduce original per-person chronological offline/prior-session training; report a separate predeclared participant-generalization extension. Group overlapping1s windows by their original trials and runs.
data_contract.controls: Motor imagery separately from execution; cue/eye/muscle/artifact nuisance controls, temporal alignment shuffle, no-neural and within-session class permutation; subject-level paired uncertainty.
data_contract.known_exclusion: Publisher reports missing event information for S07 OnlineImagery_Sess05_3class_Base; exclude or mark unusable before scoring.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Reproduce the offline-trained finger motor-imagery decoder and its recorded cross-session/fine-tuning comparisons; this does not reproduce a new human closed-loop robotic-control experiment.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

source_specific_rights_and_exposure.additional_gate: Preserve archive/code/weight terms separately. Unknown licensing is unresolved rather than presumed permissive; public access does not establish model non-exposure.

observable_endpoints.assessment: Recorded finger-imagery offline/fine-tuning comparisons are scoped; the real-time human robotic closed-loop headline cannot be recreated by replay alone.
observable_endpoints.missing_common_contract: Exact score/estimand, inclusion, figure-specific reference outputs and numerical tolerances must be frozen; source text alone does not establish reproduction.

recorded_metrics: Per-trial class accuracy/balanced accuracy and confusion matrices

comparability: Same imagery versus execution conditions, window overlap, labels and calibration budget are essential. Published human adaptation feedback is not matched by offline scoring.
Paper+data versus +official-code arms still need one identical empirical task, matched noncode resources/budgets, separate source exposure, and preserved reproduction→improvement stages.
